item.title: Live in Concert: Chase Atlantic
item.description: When WVUD got press passes to see Chase Atlantic, I got a call from Becca—our production director and a big fan—just minutes after the email went out. She asked, “Do you want to do this?” I hadn’t seen the email yet, but once I understood, I was in. We secured the passes and got ready to see Chase Atlantic at The Met in Philly on October 30.
